checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: The final deliverable is one square image.
must.why: The last image is still a tall portrait, about 384x640, not square.

must.item: Shows sleeping fox and crescent moon, both fully visible.
must.why: Fox and moon are both fully in frame.

must.item: Existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, matching details and colours.
must.why: The art is almost identical to the original fox illustration.

must.item: Does not substitute the lighthouse or combine the two.
must.why: The final image shows only the fox scene.

faults.what: The final image is not square. It is still portrait, so the main request was not met.
A stray dark blue wash strip appears on the left edge and the top-left corner. It looks like a failed outpaint and was not in the original.

summary: The final fox image keeps the art and shows the whole fox and moon, but it is still tall rather than square and has an odd blue strip on its left edge.
